comments: According to Tibetan sources, Ratnavajra was one of those scholars known as the “six gate-keeping paṇḍitas” (mkhas pa sgo drug) of the Vikramaśīla monastic seminary, and “the first of the [two] great central pillars” (dbus kyi ka chen dang po). {rGya gar chos ’byung: A, pp. 289.1–290.9} According to the colophon to the Tibetan translation of the Ratnagotravibhāga, he is the grandfather or uncle (dbon po) of the Kashmiri scholar Sajjana (sad dza na)
